answer_4.quote: Each sample is rendered as an avatar video at 24 frames per second and shown to five participants. The participants are instructed to rank the outputs based on the emotional consistency between the facial expressions and the corresponding text.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rank the generated expressions according to how well their emotions align with the input text.
